title: Artichoke Lasagne with Pecorino Bechamel
subtitle: with ricotta and roasted capsicum spread
description: A creamy vegetarian lasagne with roasted artichokes, ricotta, a capsicum and tomato spread and a pecorino bechamel, with the sheets stood upright in columns for a striking cut.

steps.text: Make the bechamel: melt the butter in a pot, add the flour and stir until absorbed.

Pour in the milk and bring to the boil, stirring. Cook for 7 to 8 minutes over medium-low heat until the sauce thickens. Season with salt, pepper and a little nutmeg, add the pecorino and stir until melted.

Assemble: spread a little bechamel on the base of a deep loaf or terrine tin. Stand the lasagne sheets up in columns across the tin instead of layering them, and between them spread bechamel, ricotta and the capsicum spread and scatter roasted artichokes. Sprinkle parmesan between the layers and on top and pour the cooking cream over so there is enough liquid to cook the pasta sheets. Cover the tin tightly with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, remove the foil and check the sheets. If they are soft, brown for 15 minutes uncovered; if not, keep covered and continue baking, then brown. Wait a few minutes before slicing.
